name: importer-fundamentals
description: The vocabulary of importing: EntityDefinition / UrlMatch / ImportableResponse (how one response decodes into resources), Extraction (run archived responses through an importer's entities), Recognizer (which importer claims a response set), and Importer (an importer as one first-class value). Pure — no DOM, no fs, no React, and no dependency on any slice; collector-fundamentals builds its live machinery on top of this package, never the reverse.
